verdict: Leads are up sharply, but Google spend efficiency demands immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 33 leads at an average cost per lead of $122.01, with the most recent 7-day window delivering a 40% surge week-over-week. All 33 leads came from Meta, which spent $1,385 to deliver them — while Google Ads consumed $2,641 over the same period and recorded only 3 conversions, a gap we are actively working to close. Separately, 111 pipeline opportunities are logged in your CRM but none have converted to appointments yet, which points to a lead intake process that needs tightening, not an ads problem. We are addressing the Google Ads efficiency and the intake flow this period, and several planned deliverables — including your website, LSA launch, and Meta retargeting — remain in progress and are being pushed to completion.

watch_item.issue: Google Ads spent $2,641 this period and produced only 3 conversions — a cost per conversion near $880 versus Meta's $42.
watch_item.fix: Google Ads targeting and conversion settings are being reviewed this week to bring that channel in line with Meta's efficiency.
